start.text: Wearing a ghostspeak amulet, talk to Velorina in Port Phasmatys.
options: Why, what is the matter?
No - could you tell me?
Yes.

necrovarus.text: Plead with Necrovarus in the temple at the west of the town.

crone.text: Bring the old crone, in her house in north-west Morytania, a cup of nettle tea; she gives you her own cup.

milkyTea.text: Pour nettle tea into her cup, add milk and give it to the old crone.

gravingas.text: Talk to Gravingas, the protestor in the town square, for a petition.
options: After hearing Velorina's story I will be happy to help out.

innkeeper.text: Ask the ghost innkeeper for a job: he gives you a bedsheet.
options: Do you have any jobs I can do?
Yes, I'd be delighted.

dip.text: Fill a bucket at the slime pool in the Ectofuntus basement and dip the bedsheet in it.

signatures.text: Wear the green bedsheet and ask the ghost villagers to sign the petition until you have 10 signatures (some want ectotokens).

burn.text: Take off the bedsheet, put the ghostspeak amulet back on and give Necrovarus the petition. Pick up the bone key he drops.

coffin.text: Unlock the door upstairs in the temple with the bone key and search the coffin for the Robes of Necrovarus.

akharanu.text: Talk to Ak-Haranu by the bank: he'll trade a translation manual for an oak longbow signed by Robin.
options: Okay, wait here - I'll get you your bow.

robin.text: Ask Robin, Master Bowman, in the inn to sign your oak longbow. He wants Runedraw games first: win four (25 coins a game) and he signs it.
options: Yes, I'll give you a game.

giveBow.text: Give the signed oak longbow to Ak-Haranu.

toyBoat.text: Ask the old crone if there is anything you can do for her: she gives you her son's toy boat.
options: You are doing so much for me - is there anything I can do for you?

repair.text: Repair the toy boat's flag with silk, a needle, thread and a knife.

mast.text: Jump across the rocks north-west of the town to the ghost ship and look at the flag on its mast when the wind is low; dye the toy boat's flag top, skull and bottom to match.

oldman.text: Show the toy boat to the old man on the ghost ship for the chest key.
options: Is this your toy boat?

unlock.text: Unlock the chest in the ghost ship's hold with the key.

scraps.text: Search the unlocked chest, the chest on the rocks north of the ship and the chest in the hold (a giant lobster guards it) for three map scraps, and put them together.

dig.text: Pay a ghost captain 25 ectotokens to sail to Dragontooth Island and dig where the map shows.

giveItems.text: Bring the robes, the translation manual and the Book of Haricanto to the old crone, wearing the ghostspeak amulet; she enchants it.

enchant.text: Talk to the old crone with your ghostspeak amulet to have it enchanted.

command.text: Wearing the enchanted amulet, command Necrovarus.
options: Let any ghost who so wishes pass on into the next world.

finish.text: Tell Velorina the good news.

generalFight.text: Talk to General Khazard; he lets the Servils go and fights you (killing him is optional).

gawain.text: Talk to Sir Gawain in the castle courtyard.
options: Do you know how Merlin got trapped?

options: Yes certainly.

getRepellent.text: Pick up the insect repellent in the house north-east of the candle maker.

repel.text: Use the insect repellent on a beehive west of Catherby.

wax.text: Use the bucket on the beehive for some wax.

giveWax.text: Give the wax to the candle maker for a black candle.

light.text: Light the black candle with your tinderbox.

altar.text: Search the chaos altar in the temple in east Varrock to learn the magic words.

summon.text: With the lit black candle and Excalibur, drop the bat bones on the magic symbol just east of Camelot Castle and bind Thrantax.
options: Snarthon Candtrick Termanto

crystal.text: Use Excalibur on Merlin's crystal at the top of the castle's north-east tower.

finish.text: Tell King Arthur that Merlin is free.

options: Ok, I'll make you some 'stabbers'.

arrows.text: Make at least six ogre arrows: cut achey tree logs into ogre arrow shafts with a knife, add feathers, then chisel wolf bones into arrowtips and add them. Bugs (a chisel and knife, 10 coins) and Fycie (25 feathers, 50 coins) are in Rantz's cave.

giveArrows.text: Give Rantz the six ogre arrows.

askToads.text: Ask Rantz how to make the chompys come.
options: How do we make the chompys come?

chest.text: In Rantz's cave, lift the rock off the ogre chest (it takes strength) and take the ogre bellows.

showToad.text: Show the bloated toad to Rantz.

drop.text: Drop the bloated toad in the clearing south of Rantz that he showed you.

watch.text: Watch Rantz try to shoot the chompy bird.

haveGo.text: Talk to Rantz and ask to have a go.

I'm actually quite strong... please let me try.

kill.text: With the ogre bow and ogre arrows, drop a bloated toad in the clearing and shoot the chompy bird that comes for it; pluck it.

showChompy.text: Show the raw chompy to Rantz.

flavours.text: Ask Bugs and Fycie in the cave what they want on their chompy (Rantz told you his).

cook.text: Cook the chompy on the spit roast by Rantz with the three seasonings.

finish.text: Give the seasoned chompy to Rantz.

rewards: The ability to make ogre arrows

options: I need to find some goutweed.

cook.text: Talk to Burntmeat, the troll cook upstairs in the Troll Stronghold.

eadgar2.text: Tell Mad Eadgar what the cook wants; he has a plan and wants a parrot.

pete.text: Ask Parroty Pete in the Ardougne Zoo about the aviary: when it was added and what the parrots eat.
options: When did you add it?
What do you feed them?

catch.text: Soak pineapple chunks in vodka, gin, brandy or whisky and use the alco-chunks on the aviary hatch.

eadgar3.text: Bring the drunk parrot to Mad Eadgar.

hide.text: Hide the parrot under the rack in the Troll Stronghold prison.

eadgar4.text: Go back to Mad Eadgar for the rest of his plan.

robe.text: Get a dirty robe from Tegid, doing his laundry by the lake in Taverley.
options: Sanfew won't be happy...

items.text: Bring Mad Eadgar logs, 5 raw chickens, 10 grain and the dirty robe for the fake human.

thistle.text: Pick a troll thistle on the mountain east of Trollheim, dry it on a fire, grind it and put it in a ranarr potion (unf).

potion.text: Give the troll potion to Mad Eadgar.

fetch.text: Fetch the parrot back from the prison rack.

eadgar5.text: Bring the parrot to Mad Eadgar; he gives you the fake man.

giveman.text: Give the fake man to Burntmeat the troll cook.

drawers.text: Open the kitchen drawers and search them for the storeroom key.

storeroom.text: Unlock the storeroom on the ground floor and take goutweed from the crates, out of sight of the guards.

finish.text: Give the goutweed to Sanfew.

elena.name: Plague City
elena.start: Talk to Edmond in his house in north-west East Ardougne.

dwellberries.name: Dwellberries
dwellberries.tip: Picked up in McGrubor's Wood, north-west of Seers' Village

water.name: Bucket of water
water.tip: Fill buckets at a sink, well or fountain

rope.name: Rope
rope.tip: Sold by general stores; the Khazard general store south of Ardougne has them

gasmask.name: Gas mask
gasmask.tip: Alrena gives it; a spare is in her cupboard

milk.name: Bucket of milk
milk.tip: Use a bucket on a dairy cow

dust.name: Chocolate dust
dust.tip: Grind a chocolate bar with a pestle and mortar (the baker in East Ardougne sells chocolate bars)

snape.name: Snape grass
snape.tip: Grows on the Hobgoblin peninsula west of Rimmington, and by the coast north of Rellekka

start.text: Talk to Edmond in his house in north-west East Ardougne.
options: What's happened to her?
Can I help find her?

berries.text: Pick up some dwellberries in McGrubor's Wood.

alrena.text: Give the dwellberries to Alrena in Edmond's house.

edmond.text: Talk to Edmond about getting into West Ardougne.

soften.text: Use 4 buckets of water on the mud patch in Edmond's garden.

dig.text: Use the spade on the mud patch to dig into the sewer.

grill.text: Use the rope on the grill at the end of the sewer.

pull.text: Talk to Edmond in the sewer to pull the grill off together.

picture.text: Pick up the picture in Edmond's house.

pipe.text: Wear the gas mask and climb through the sewer pipe into West Ardougne.

jethick.text: Talk to Jethick in West Ardougne and show him the picture.
options: I'm looking for a woman from East Ardougne.

rehnisons.text: Knock on the Rehnisons' door, north of Jethick, and return the book.

ted.text: Talk to Ted or Martha Rehnison.

plagueDoor.text: Try the door of the plague house in the south of West Ardougne and talk to the mourner.
options: I fear not a mere plague.

clerk.text: Talk to the clerk in the civic office.
options: I need permission to enter a plague house.
This is urgent though!
This is really important though!
Do you know what is in the cure?

chocmilk.text: Use the chocolate dust on a bucket of milk.

cure.text: Use the snape grass on the chocolatey milk to make the hangover cure.

giveCure.text: Give Bravek the hangover cure by talking to him, then ask for help.
options: They won't listen to me!

warrantDoor.text: Show the warrant at the plague house door.

barrel.text: Search the barrel in the plague house for a small key.

cellar.text: Go down the stairs, use the key on the cell door and talk to Elena.

finish.text: Return to Edmond.

elid.name: Spirits of the Elid
elid.start: Talk to Awusah the Mayor in his house in Nardah.

rope.name: Rope
rope.tip: One for the root at the river's source, one for the crevice

ranged.name: A ranged weapon and ammo, or runes for a combat spell
ranged.tip: To shoot the target in the black golem's room

knife.name: Knife
knife.tip: To cut the soles off the shoes

tornRobes.name: Torn robes
tornRobes.tip: In a cupboard in the shrine

skills: Able to defeat three level 75 golems

start.text: Talk to Awusah the Mayor in his house in Nardah and agree to help.
options: I am an adventurer in search of quests.
Any idea how you got this curse?
Yes.

ghaslor.text: Ask Ghaslor the Elder, north of the mayor's house, about the curse.
options: I am trying to find out the cause of this town's curse.
River spirits, what are they?

read.text: Read the ballad Ghaslor gave you.

cupboard.text: Search the cupboards in the shrine in the west of Nardah for torn robes.

mend.text: Mend both torn robes with a needle and thread.

key.text: Take the ancestral key on display in the shrine.

cave.text: Go north to the source of the River Elid and use a rope on the root by the waterfall to climb down. Wearing the robes of Elidinis, with the key and the ballad, open the great stone doors.

golems.text: Defeat the three golems behind the doors (white to the south, grey to the east, black to the north-east), then clear each room's water channel: pick the white room's lock (37 Thieving), mine the grey room's rocks (37 Mining) and shoot the black room's target with arrows or a spell (37 Ranged).

spirits.text: Go through the doors north to the lake and speak to the spirits of the Elid as an emissary of Nardah.
options: I come as an emissary from the people of Nardah.
Is there anything they can do to get their fountain working again?

awusah.text: Tell Awusah what the spirits said.

genie.text: Climb down the crevice west of Nardah with a rope and ask the genie for the statue; agree to his deal.
options: I'm after a statue that was thrown down here.
Maybe I can make a deal for it?
Ok I agree to the deal.

shoes.text: Take Awusah's shoes from his house.

cut.text: Step outside the mayor's house and cut the soles off the shoes with a knife.

trade.text: Give the sole to the genie for the statuette.

plinth.text: Put the statuette on the plinth in the shrine.

rewards: Access to Nardah's fountain and shrine

feud.name: The Feud
feud.start: Talk to Ali Morrisane at his stall in the north of Al Kharid.

coins.name: Coins
coins.tip: For beers, camels and Ali Morrisane's disguise

beer.name: Beer
beer.tip: Ali the Barman in Pollnivneach sells it

beard.name: Fake beard
beard.tip: Sold by Ali Morrisane and the Pollnivneach general store

turban.name: Desert disguise
turban.tip: Sold by Ali Morrisane and the Pollnivneach general store

blackjack.name: Blackjack
blackjack.tip: Sold by Ali the Blackjack seller in Pollnivneach

dung.name: Bucket of camel dung
dung.tip: Collect fresh dung from Ali the Camel Man's camels with an empty bucket

flute.name: Snake charm
flute.tip: The snake charmer in Pollnivneach gives it (talk to him with a coin)

skills: Able to defeat level 70 and 75 fighters

start.text: Talk to Ali Morrisane at his stall in the north of Al Kharid.
options: Okay.
I'd like to help you, but...
Yes.

drunk.text: Go to Pollnivneach, south of the Shantay Pass, and buy Drunken Ali in the bar a few beers.

gangs.text: Talk to a bandit and a Menaphite thug about their feud.

camels.text: Buy two camels from Ali the Camel Man.

receipts.text: Give a camel receipt to a bandit and to a Menaphite thug.

operator.text: Talk to Ali the Operator by the Menaphites' tent and join the gang.

pickpocket.text: Pick the pockets of three villagers (Ali the Operator has advice if you're stuck and the street urchin can help); buy a blackjack to knock one out.

stakeout.text: Put on a disguise (fake beard and desert disguise) and gloves, and stake out the mayor's house from behind the cactus.

jewels.text: Let yourself into the mayor's house with the keys and search upstairs for the jewels.

jewels2.text: Take the jewels to Ali the Operator.

traitor.text: Ask the Menaphite thugs about the traitor, then tell Ali the Operator.

snake.text: Charm a desert snake into the basket with the snake charm and give it to Ali the Hag with a bucket of fresh camel dung for a poison.

poisonDrink.text: Use the poison on Traitorous Ali's drink in the bar (Ali the Barman knows where he is).

told.text: Tell Ali the Operator the drink is poisoned.

leader.text: Talk to the Menaphite leader outside the tent and see off his men.

bandits.text: Talk to a villager, then beat the bandit leader's champion in the bandit camp north of the town.

mayor.text: Talk to a villager, then to Ali the Mayor.

finish.text: Tell Ali Morrisane in Al Kharid about his nephew.

fishingcompo.name: Fishing Contest
fishingcompo.start: Talk to a dwarf by the tunnel stairs on White Wolf Mountain (either end).

spade.name: Spade
spade.tip: To dig up red vine worms

garlic.name: Garlic
garlic.tip: In the cupboard upstairs in Morgan's house, Draynor

worms.name: Red vine worm
worms.tip: Dig them up with a spade at the vines in McGrubor's Wood

on: you stash the garlic in the pipe

start.text: Talk to a dwarf by the tunnel stairs on White Wolf Mountain.
options: I was just wondering what was down those stairs?
Why not?
If you were my friend I wouldn't mind.
Well, let's be friends!
And how am I meant to do that?
Fortunately I'm alright at fishing!

worms.text: Dig up some red vine worms with a spade at the vines in McGrubor's Wood (through the loose railing).

garlic.text: Show Morris your pass at the Hemenster gate, then use the garlic on the pipe by the Sinister Stranger's spot.

enter.text: Pay Bonzo 5 coins to enter the competition.
options: I'll enter the competition please.

fish.text: Fish at the spot by the pipe with your rod and the red vine worms until you catch a giant carp, then give it to Bonzo.

bonzo.text: Bring the giant carp to Bonzo.

finish.text: Bring the trophy to the dwarves on White Wolf Mountain.

rewards: Use of the White Wolf Mountain tunnel

fluffs.name: Gertrude's Cat
fluffs.start: Talk to Gertrude in her house west of Varrock.

milk.name: Bucket of milk
milk.tip: Use a bucket on the dairy cow north of the Lumbridge mill

sardine.name: Raw sardine
sardine.tip: Gerrant sells them in Port Sarim, or catch one with a fishing rod and bait

seasoned.name: Seasoned sardine
seasoned.tip: Use the doogle leaves on a raw sardine

start.text: Talk to Gertrude in her house west of Varrock.
options: Well, I suppose I could.

boys.text: Talk to Shilop in the Varrock marketplace while Wilough is next to him, and pay them 100 coins.
options: What will make you tell me?
Okay then, I'll pay.

getMilk.text: Get a bucket of milk: use a bucket on the dairy cow north of the Lumbridge mill.

fence.text: Go to the old lumber mill north-east of Varrock and climb through the broken fence.

ladderUp.text: Climb the ladder in the lumber mill.

milkCat.text: Use the bucket of milk on Fluffs.

leaves.text: Pick up some doogle leaves behind Gertrude's house.

sardine.text: Buy a raw sardine from Gerrant in Port Sarim.

season.text: Use the doogle leaves on the raw sardine.

feedCat.text: Use the seasoned sardine on Fluffs, upstairs in the lumber mill.

crates.text: Search the crates in the lumber yard where you hear kittens mewing until you find the kitten.

finish.text: Return to Gertrude.

forget.name: Forgettable Tale...
forget.start: Talk to Commander Veldaban in the Black Guard headquarters in Keldagrim.

seeds.name: Kelda seeds
seeds.tip: The drunken dwarf and his drinking buddies have them

yeast.name: Ale yeast
yeast.tip: A pot of ale yeast for the vat

skills: The Giant Dwarf and Fishing Contest completed

travel.text: Go to Keldagrim: take the cart from the dwarven mine under Ice Mountain (150 coins), or the boat from the Keldagrim entrance cave east of Rellekka.

start.text: Talk to Commander Veldaban in the Black Guard headquarters.
options: Very interested!
Yes.

drunk.text: Talk to the drunken dwarf in the north-east of Keldagrim-East about the Red Axe.
options: I need to know about the Red Axe...

seeds.text: Collect the other three Kelda seeds from the drunken dwarf's drinking buddies, then ask Rind the gardener in the palace garden about growing them.

grow.text: Rake the palace's Kelda hops patch, plant the seeds and pick the hops when they've grown.

brew.text: Upstairs in the Laughing Miner, put two buckets of water, two barley malt, the Kelda hops and a pot of ale yeast in the brewing vat; once it has fermented, open the valve and fill a glass from the barrel.

drunk2.text: Give the Kelda stout to the drunken dwarf.

conductor.text: Ask the cart conductor nearest the boarded-up tunnel south of the cart station about it.

director.text: Ask the director of your Consortium company to have the boards removed.

mine.text: Ride a cart into the old mine from the cart station and work through the chasms: set the track junctions so the cart gets across, listening in on the Red Axe and searching their records.

kebab.text: Go to the Laughing Miner in Keldagrim-East.

start.text: Talk to Queen Ellamaria in the garden east of Varrock palace and agree to help.
options: I would be happy to help someone who is so in touch with the people.

wom.text: Ask the Wise Old Man in Draynor Village for guidance and bring him the Ring of Charos. Pass his test: 1 show them a range of colours, 2 take the kebab, 3 "It's absolutely, unquestionably the most interesting thing...", 4 put on the silly helmet, 5 "You of course Pkmaster0036...", 6 "Ask me nicely and I might consider it."; the seventh answer doesn't matter.
options: Queen Ellamaria has sent me to seek your guidance.
I've brought the Ring of Charos, as instructed.
Can I retake the diplomacy test?

overview.text: Gather everything on the list (the steps below) wearing the opened Ring of Charos, and plant it all in the garden's patches. When everything has grown, tell Queen Ellamaria.
options: Well, I think that's everything...

elstan.text: Ask Elstan at the farming patches south of Falador for delphinium seeds, charm him and agree to grow marigolds in his flower patch; pick them and give them to him.
options: Do you have any delphinium seeds to spare?
(Charm) That is why I have come to an expert for advice.
(Charm) Not just AN expert, Elstan - they say you are THE expert.
(Charm) Oh no, I love listening to gardening stories...
(Charm) Millions? Ah, just what I wanted to hear...
Okay, I'll grow you some marigolds.

lyra.text: Ask Lyra at the farming patches west of Port Phasmatys for orchid seeds, charm her and agree to grow a patch of onions; then tell her they've grown.
options: Do you have any orchid seeds to spare?
(Charm) If you tell me your problems, I may be able to help you.
(Charm) Yes, I was wondering about that.
(Charm) Times must be very hard for you.
(Charm) Whatever you've done, I'm sure you had just cause.
(Charm) And what is the nature of this fee that you pay?
(Charm) If not yours, then whose blood are you offering?
(Charm) How can you deal with so much guilt?
That's a deal - I'll grow a patch of onions for you.
Okay, I've grown those onions like you asked.

kragen.text: Ask Kragen at the farming patches north of Ardougne for snowdrop seeds, charm him and agree to grow cabbages; then tell him they've grown.
options: Do you have any snowdrop seeds to spare?
(Charm) You seem to be a little irritable, my friend.
(Charm) I don't like to see a fellow human being so upset.
(Charm) So what ails you, my friend?
(Charm) Well, is there anything I can do for you?
(Charm) So what can I do for you?
That's a deal - I'll let you know when your cabbages are ready.
Okay, I've grown those cabbages like you asked.

dantaera.text: Ask Dantaera at the farming patches in Catherby how to grow a White Tree and charm her into letting you take a cutting.
options: Do you know how I could grow a White Tree?
(Charm) I think that there is something that you are not telling me.
(Charm) A secret is a dreadful burden to have to keep to yourself.
(Charm) Unless you allow me to do this she will die anyway.

shoot.text: Cut a shoot from the dead White Tree on Ice Mountain with secateurs.

pot.text: Put the shoot in a plant pot of soil and water it until it grows into a sapling.

bernald.text: Talk to Bernald in Burthorpe, charm him and accept his deal; use a plant cure on his diseased vines.
options: (Charm) But it is the only way that these vines will be cured.
I accept the deal.

alain.text: Ask Alain at the tree patch in Taverley about strong plant cures (not with a charm). Then crush rune essence with a hammer, grind the shards with a pestle and mortar and mix the dust into a plant cure.
options: I need to ask you about strong plant cures.
Are you sure there's nothing you can suggest?

vines.text: Use the strong plant cure on Bernald's vines, then get the vine seeds from him.

althric.text: Admire Brother Althric's rosebushes at Edgeville Monastery with the ring on; he tells you to get rid of it.
options: (Charm) These are the most beautiful rosebushes I've ever seen.

well.text: Throw the Ring of Charos(u) down the well west of Edgeville bank, talk to Brother Althric again and take seeds from his red, pink and white rosebushes. Fish the ring back out of the well with a fishing rod.

statues.text: Ask Queen Ellamaria for a trolley, use it on the statue of Saradomin in Falador park and on the statue of a king outside Lumbridge Castle, and push each back to its plinth in the garden within about five minutes.
options: How am I supposed to move statues all the way here?

plant.text: Plant the seeds and the sapling in their patches in the garden and wait for everything to grow.

roald.text: Fetch King Roald from the palace and charm him into following you to the garden.
options: Would you like to follow me for a minute?
(Charm) Of course, your majesty - please forgive me.
(Charm) The Queen asked me to bring you.

rewards: An acorn and an apple tree seed

options: Aha, sounds like a quest. I'll help.

oddenstein.text: Go into Draynor Manor and up to the top floor. Talk to Professor Oddenstein.
options: I'm looking for a guy called Ernest.
Change him back this instant!

fishfood.text: Pick up the fish food on the first floor of the manor.

poison.text: Pick up the poison on the ground floor of the manor.

mix.text: Use the poison on the fish food.

fountain.text: Use the poisoned fish food on the fountain south-west of the manor.

gauge.text: Search the fountain for the pressure gauge.

spade.text: Pick up the spade outside the east side of the manor.

compost.text: Use the spade on the compost heap west of the manor to find a key.

tube.text: Use the key on the door in the manor's north-east room and pick up the rubber tube behind it.

bookcase.text: Search the bookcase in the west room of the manor from its east side to find a secret door.

ladderDown.text: Climb down the ladder in the secret room.

puzzle.text: Solve the lever puzzle (the doors open by the levers): 1) Pull levers A and B down. 2) Go north into the room with levers C and D and pull D down. 3) Go west, then south, back to the first room, and pull A and B up. 4) Go north, west, then north into the room with levers E and F and pull both down. 5) Go east, then east again into the room with C and D, and pull C down. 6) Go west twice back to E and F and pull E up. 7) Go east, south, south, then west through the door to the oil can, and pick it up.

ladderUp.text: Go back east through the door and climb the ladder.

lever.text: Pull the lever to open the secret door.

finish.text: Bring the pressure gauge, rubber tube and oil can to Professor Oddenstein on the top floor of the manor.

chisel.tip: Crates by the lift have chisels

skills: Priest in Peril completed (access to Morytania)

i wonder if that cart is anywhere useful now

start.text: Tell the Saradominist zealot you follow Saradomin and are seeking quests, ask about his quest, then ask whether there is any other way into the mines (he mentions his key).
options: I follow the path of Saradomin.
I come seeking challenges and quests.
What quest is that then?
Is there any other way into the mines?

key.text: If you haven't yet, ask the zealot whether there is any other way into the mines; then pick his pocket for his key.
options: Is there any other way into the mines?

enterB.text: Crawl into the mine through the southern tunnel in the rocks west of the mine.

ladderB.text: Climb down the ladder at the end of the tunnel.

fungus.text: Find your way through the mine to the flooded corner with glowing fungus and pick some.

cart.text: Put the glowing fungus into the mine cart.

points.text: Set the points so the cart reaches the far end of the track, then send it from the control panel. The levers are lettered: the cart gets through with points A and B switched one way and C, D and J the other (the panel shows the track; the others don't matter). Start with the panel to see how they're set.
points.note: Levers A to E stand together east of the panel, I to K to the north.

leave.text: Go back out of the mine the way you came, to use the other tunnel.

enterA.text: Crawl into the mine through the tunnel behind the cart obstacle (squeeze past the cart: 15 Agility).

ladderA.text: Climb down the ladder at the end of the tunnel.

endCart.text: Find the mine cart at the end of the track and take the glowing fungus out of it.

valve.text: Go to the lift, use the zealot's key on the valve beside it and open the valve, then get in the lift (a ghost may close the valve again). Take a chisel from a crate here if you need one.

stairs.text: From the flooded chamber, go down the stairs carrying the glowing fungus to light the way.

stairsDark.text: It's too dark below without a light: bring a glowing fungus down in the lift (it has to cross over in the mine cart, see above), then take the stairs.

bossKey.text: Try to take the key in the room through the door; Treus Dayth appears.

door.text: Unlock the double doors with the key and go through.

crystals.text: Cut a shard from the crystals with a chisel.

minder.text: Go to the monkey cage at Ardougne Zoo and, as a Karamjan monkey, talk to a Monkey Minder; he puts you in the cage.

zooMonkey.text: In the cage, take off the greegree (keep the amulet on) and talk a monkey into jumping into your backpack.

minderOut.text: As a human, talk to a Monkey Minder to be let out of the cage.

back.text: Head back to Ape Atoll with the monkey: Daero in the Grand Tree takes you to the hangar, Waydar flies you to Crash Island and Lumdo ferries you over.

captive.text: Take the monkey back to Awowogei (as a monkey) and give it to him.

garkorPlan.text: Talk to Garkor, who overheard a disturbing conversation.

garkorSigil.text: Talk to Garkor again about his plan; he gives you a 10th squad sigil.

sigil.text: Get ready for a big fight (food, prayer potions, Protect from Melee helps), then wear the sigil: you are summoned with the 10th squad.

demon.text: Kill the Jungle Demon (level 195) with the 10th squad.

narnode.text: Return to King Narnode in the Grand Tree and report.

finish.text: With 3 free inventory spaces, talk to King Narnode for your reward.

rewards: The right to wield dragon scimitars

mortton.name: Shades of Mort'ton
mortton.start: Explore the town of Mort'ton at the southern edge of Mort Myre and find Herbi Flax's diary.

diary.name: Diary
diary.tip: On the shelf in the ruined house in the west of Mort'ton

tarromin.name: Tarromin potion (unf)
tarromin.tip: The experiment table next to the shelf has tarromin

remains.name: Loar remains
remains.tip: Dropped by the Loar Shades around the town

paste.name: Swamp paste
paste.tip: Five for each repair; Razmire's building store sells it

diary.text: Search the shelf in the ruined house in the west of Mort'ton for Herbi Flax's diary and read it.

serum.text: Search the experiment table for herbs, make a tarromin potion (unf) and add ashes to make Serum 207.

razmire.text: Use the serum on Razmire Keelgan, then ask him about the shadow creatures and agree to kill five Shades.
options: What are all these shadow creatures?
Yes, I'll dispatch those dark and evil creatures.

shades.text: Kill five Loar Shades around Mort'ton and keep their remains.

razmire2.text: Show the five Loar remains to Razmire.

ulsquire.text: Use the serum on Ulsquire Shauncy and show him the remains; ask him about the temple.
options: What can you tell me about that temple?

temple.text: Repair the walls of Flamtaer temple north-east of Mort'ton with a hammer: each repair takes a plank, a limestone brick and five swamp paste. Keep going until every wall stands.

oil.text: Use the olive oil on the fire altar in the middle of the temple to make sacred oil.

pyreLogs.text: Use the sacred oil on some logs to make pyre logs.

pyre.text: Put the pyre logs on a funeral pyre west of Mort'ton, then the Loar remains, and light it.

finish.text: Tell Ulsquire you've put the Shade to rest.

murder.name: Murder Mystery
murder.start: Talk to a guard at the Sinclair Mansion north of Seers' Village.

pot.name: Pot
pot.tip: Sold by the Lumbridge general store

flour.name: Pot of flour
flour.tip: Use a pot on the flour barrel in the mansion kitchen

flypaper.name: Flypaper
flypaper.tip: In the sacks in the mansion

dagger.name: Criminal's dagger
dagger.tip: Lying in the room with the broken window

pungent.name: Pungent pot
pungent.tip: Lying in the room with the broken window

start.text: Talk to a guard at the Sinclair Mansion north of Seers' Village.
options: Sure, I'll help.

thread.text: Search the broken window in the room at the east of the mansion for the thread.

dagger.text: Pick up the criminal's dagger and the pungent pot in the same room.

flour.text: Use a pot on the flour barrel in the kitchen, and take some flypaper from the sacks next to it.

printDagger.text: Use the pot of flour on the dagger, then the flypaper on the dusted dagger to lift an unknown print.

silver.text: Search the barrels around the mansion for the family's silver items (two on the ground floor, four upstairs). Dust each with flour, lift its print with flypaper, and use it on the unknown print until one matches.

salesman.text: Ask the poison salesman in Seers' Village who he sold poison to.
options: Who did you sell Poison to at the house?

poison.text: Ask the family member whose print matched "Why'd you buy poison the other day?", then search the place they say they used it on (the compost heap, beehive, kitchen drain, spiders' nest, fountain or family crest).
options: Why'd you buy poison the other day?

finish.text: Tell a guard you know who did it.
options: I know who did it!

onesmallfavour.name: One Small Favour
onesmallfavour.start: Talk to Yanni Salika in Shilo Village.

blunt.name: Blunt axe
blunt.tip: The jungle forester gives another if you lose it

steel.name: Steel bar
steel.tip: 3 for Horvik, 1 for the weather vane

hotwater.name: Cup of hot water
hotwater.tip: Pour a bowl of hot water into an empty cup

gems.name: Uncut sapphire, opal, red topaz and jade

skills: Rune Mysteries, Shilo Village and Druidic Ritual completed
Able to defeat a level 92 Slagilith and three level 49 dwarves

start.text: Talk to Yanni Salika in Shilo Village and agree to get some red mahogany.
options: Is there anything else interesting to do around here?
Yes.

forester.text: Talk to the jungle forester south of Shilo Village; take his blunt axe to Captain Shanks.
options: I need to talk to you about red mahogany.
Okay, I'll take your axe to get it sharpened.

shanks.text: Talk to Captain Shanks on his ship west of Shilo Village and ask him the favour.
options: Actually I have a favour to ask.

brian.text: Take the blunt axe to Brian's axe shop in Port Sarim; agree to see Aggie.
options: Do you sharpen axes?
Ok, ok, I'll do it! I'll go and see Aggie.

aggie.text: Ask Aggie in Draynor Village to be a character witness, and agree to find Jimmy the Chisel.
options: Could I ask you about being a character witness?
Let me guess, you're going to ask me to do you a favour?
Oh, Ok, I'll see if I can find Jimmy.

johanhus.text: Pick the lock of the trapdoor in the ruined building between Draynor and Lumbridge, go down and ask Johanhus Ulsbrecht about Jimmy.
options: I'm looking for Jimmy the Chisel.
And I suppose you need me to do you a favour?
Ok, Jimmy has to be worth more than a few scrawny chickens!

fred.text: Talk to Fred the Farmer north of Lumbridge about Jimmy.
options: I need to talk to you about Jimmy.

seth.text: Ask Seth Groats at the farm east of the River Lum for chickens.
options: Oh, ok! I guess it's not that much further to Varrock!

horvik.text: Take 3 steel bars to Horvik in Varrock.
options: Hi, I need to talk to you about chicken cages!
Ok, I guess one good turn deserves another.

apothecary.text: Get medicine for Horvik from the Apothecary in Varrock.
options: Talk about One Small Favour.
I guess I can go to the Barbarian Village.

tassie.text: Ask Tassie Slipcast in Barbarian Village for an airtight pot.
options: Ok, I'll deal with Hammerspike!

hammerspike.text: Talk to Hammerspike Stoutbeard in the west of the Dwarven Mine and offer to get him into the druids.
options: Have you always been a gangster?
Ok, another favour...I think I can manage that.

sanfew.text: Ask Sanfew upstairs in Taverley to take Hammerspike as an initiate.
options: Are you taking any new initiates?
A dwarf I know wants to become an initiate.
Yep, it's a deal.

teaMake.text: Make a Guthix rest tea: add a harralander, a marrentill and two guam leaves to a cup of hot water.

bleemadge.text: Take the Guthix rest to Captain Bleemadge on White Wolf Mountain.
options: I have a special tea here for you from Sanfew!

bleemadge2.text: Talk to Captain Bleemadge again and agree to get him some T.R.A.S.H.
options: How was that tea?
Ok, I'll go and get you some T.R.A.S.H.

arhein.text: Ask Arhein in Catherby for some T.R.A.S.H.
options: I need to talk T.R.A.S.H. to you.
Yes, Ok, I'll do it!

farsight.text: Ask Phantuwti Fanstuwi Farsight in Seers' Village for a weather forecast, and offer to help.
options: Hi, can you give me a weather forecast?
What can I do to help?
Yes, Ok, I'll do it.

petra.text: Search the sculpture of a girl in the caves south-west of Seers' Village.

cromperty.text: Talk to Wizard Cromperty in East Ardougne.
options: I need to talk to you about a girl stuck in some rock!
Oh! Ok, one more 'small favour' isn't going to kill me...I hope!

tindel.text: Ask Tindel Marchant in Port Khazard for some iron oxide; he gives you a mattress.
options: Wizard Cromperty sent me to get some iron oxide.
Okay, I'll do it!

rantz.text: Take the mattress to Rantz in the Feldip Hills.
options: I need to talk to you about a mattress.
Ok, I'll see what I can do.

gnormadium.text: Talk to Gnormadium Avlafrim by the glider landing site and offer to help.
options: Rantz said I should help you finish this project.
Yes, I'll take a look at them.

lights.text: Search each of the 8 landing lights for its gem, cut the gem with a chisel and put it back.
lights.note: Gnormadium sells a chisel for 10 coins.

lightsDone.text: Tell Gnormadium Avlafrim you've fixed the lights.
options: I've fixed all the lights!

rantz2.text: Take the mattress back to Rantz to have it filled.
options: Ok, I've helped that Gnome, he shouldn't bother you anymore.

tindel2.text: Take the comfy mattress to Tindel Marchant.
options: I have the mattress.

cromperty2.text: Take the iron oxide to Wizard Cromperty.
options: I have that iron oxide you asked for!

readScroll.text: Read the animate rock scroll by Petra's sculpture.

slagilith.text: Defeat the Slagilith you animated by mistake (only crush weapons hurt it).

readAgain.text: Read the scroll again to free Petra.

farsight2.text: Tell Phantuwti that Petra is free, and ask to see the weather vane.
options: I've released Petra, she should have returned.
Ok, show me where this weather vane is...I want to look at it.

vane.text: On the roof of Phantuwti's house, hit the weather vane with a hammer and search it for its three broken parts.

anvil.text: Mend the parts on an anvil: the ornament with a bronze bar, the pillar with an iron bar and the directionals with a steel bar.

vaneFix.text: Put the three mended parts back on the weather vane.

farsight3.text: Tell Phantuwti you've fixed the weather vane.
options: I've fixed the weather vane!

arhein2.text: Take the weather report to Arhein in Catherby.
options: I have the weather report for you.

bleemadge3.text: Ask Captain Bleemadge if he got his T.R.A.S.H.
options: Hey there, did you get your T.R.A.S.H?

sanfew2.text: Tell Sanfew that the pilot will take him to the ogres.
options: Hi there, the Gnome Pilot has agreed to take you to see the ogres!

hammerspike2.text: Tell Hammerspike Stoutbeard that Sanfew will take him.

tassie2.text: Tell Tassie Slipcast that Hammerspike won't bother her; she gives you clay.

potlid.text: Soften the clay, make a pot lid on the potter's wheel, fire it in the oven and put it on an empty pot.

apothecary2.text: Take the airtight pot to the Apothecary.
options: Talk about One Small Favour.

horvik2.text: Take the breathing salts and herbal tincture to Horvik.
options: I have the tincture and the breathing salts.
I have the five pigeon cages you asked for!

seth2.text: Take the chicken cages to Seth Groats.

johanhus2.text: Tell Johanhus Ulsbrecht the chickens are coming.
options: You're in luck, I've managed to swing that chicken deal for you.

aggie2.text: Tell Aggie that Jimmy has been released.
options: Good news! Jimmy has been released!

brian2.text: Tell Brian that Aggie will be his character witness; he sharpens the axe.
options: I've returned with good news.

forester2.text: Take the sharpened axe to the jungle forester.
options: Good news, I have your sharpened axe!

finish.text: Take the red mahogany to Yanni Salika.
options: Here's the red mahogany you asked for.

priest.name: The Restless Ghost
priest.start: Talk to Father Aereck in the church in Lumbridge.

amulet.name: Amulet of ghostspeak
amulet.tip: Father Urhney gives you another if you lose it

aereck.text: Talk to Father Aereck in the Lumbridge church.
options: I'm looking for a quest!
Ok, let me help then.

urhney.text: Talk to Father Urhney in his hut in Lumbridge Swamp.
options: Father Aereck sent me to talk to you.
He's got a ghost haunting his graveyard.

coffin.text: Wear the amulet of ghostspeak and open the coffin in the graveyard to make the ghost appear.

ghost.text: Talk to the ghost while wearing the amulet of ghostspeak.
options: Yep, now tell me what the problem is.
Yes, ok. Do you know why you're a ghost?

tower.text: Climb down the ladder into the Wizards' Tower basement, south of Draynor.

skull.text: Pick up the ghost's skull in the far corner of the basement. A skeleton appears and attacks: you can just run.

openCoffin.text: Open the coffin in the Lumbridge graveyard.

putSkull.text: Use the skull on the open coffin to finish the quest.

priestperil.name: Priest in Peril
priestperil.start: Talk to King Roald in Varrock Palace.

bucket.name: Bucket
bucket.tip: For water from the well in the mausoleum

goldkey.name: Golden key
goldkey.tip: The monks in the temple drop it

ironkey.name: Iron key
ironkey.tip: Swap the golden key for it at the right monument

essence.name: Rune or pure essence
essence.tip: Unnoted; mine it at the Rune Essence mine

skills: Able to defeat a level 30 temple guardian and level 30 monks

start.text: Talk to King Roald in Varrock Palace.
options: I'm looking for a quest!
Sure.

doors.text: Knock at the doors of the temple of Paterdomus, east of Varrock over the river.
options: Roald sent me to check on Drezel.
Sure.

dog.text: Go down the trapdoor north of the temple and kill the temple guardian.

drezel.text: Go into the temple, up to the top floor, and talk to Drezel through the cell door.
options: Tell me anyway.
Yes.

monks.text: Kill the monks in the temple for the golden key.

monument.text: In the mausoleum, study the monuments and use the golden key on the one holding the iron key.

well.text: Use a bucket on the well in the mausoleum for murky water.

unlock.text: Use the iron key on Drezel's cell door.

bless.text: Talk to Drezel with the murky water so he blesses it.

coffin.text: Use the blessed water on the coffin.

mausoleum.text: Meet Drezel in the mausoleum, past the gates at its east end.

essence.text: Bring Drezel 50 rune essence (or pure essence); use them on him.

prince.name: Prince Ali Rescue
prince.start: Talk to Hassan in the Al Kharid palace.

clay.name: Clay
clay.tip: Mine it in the mine south-west of Varrock

water.name: Bucket or jug of water
water.tip: Fill a bucket or jug at a well, fountain or sink; Hassan also hands you a jug of water if you tell him it is too hot

softclay.name: Soft clay
softclay.tip: Use clay on a bucket or jug of water

bronze.name: Bronze bar
bronze.tip: Smelt a copper ore and a tin ore at a furnace (Lumbridge has one), or buy one from Shantay

key.name: Key to the prince's door
key.tip: Leela gives it once Osman has had it made

wool.name: Ball of wool
wool.tip: Shear sheep and spin the wool on a spinning wheel (Lumbridge Castle, first floor)

plainwig.name: Wig
plainwig.tip: Ned makes it from 3 balls of wool

onion.name: Onion
onion.tip: Pick them in the field north of Rimmington

yellowdye.name: Yellow dye
yellowdye.tip: Aggie makes it from 2 onions and 5 coins

redberries.name: Redberries
redberries.tip: Picked up south-east of Varrock, or bought from Wydin in Port Sarim

flour.name: Pot of flour
flour.tip: Grind wheat at the mill north of Lumbridge

ashes.name: Ashes
ashes.tip: Left behind when a fire burns out

paste.name: Paste
paste.tip: Aggie mixes it from ashes, flour, water and redberries

rope.name: Rope
rope.tip: Ned sells it for 15 coins (or makes it from 4 balls of wool)

beer.name: Beer
beer.tip: The bartender in the Rusty Anchor, Port Sarim, or the Blue Moon Inn, Varrock, sells it

coins.name: Coins
coins.tip: 5 for the dye and 15 for the rope

start.text: Talk to Hassan in the Al Kharid palace.
options: Can I help you? You must need some help here in the desert.

osman.text: Talk to Osman, just north of the palace.
options: What is the first thing I must do?
Okay, I better go find some things.

clay.text: Mine some clay in the mine south-west of Varrock.

softclay.text: Use the clay on a bucket or jug of water to make soft clay.

keli.text: Talk to Lady Keli in the jail east of Draynor Village and take an imprint of her key.
options: Heard of you? You are famous in RuneScape!
What is your latest plan then?
Can you be sure they will not try to get him out?
Could I see the key please?
Could I touch the key for a moment?

bronze.text: Get a bronze bar: smelt a copper ore and a tin ore at the furnace in Lumbridge.

osmanKey.text: Bring the key print and the bronze bar to Osman.

leelaKey.text: Talk to Leela, east of Draynor Village, to collect the key.

wool.text: Get 3 balls of wool: shear sheep and spin the wool on a spinning wheel.

nedWig.text: Talk to Ned in Draynor Village and ask him to make a wig.
options: Ned, could you make other things from wool?
How about some sort of wig?
I have that now. Please, make me a wig.

onions.text: Pick 2 onions in the field north of Rimmington.

yellowDye.text: Talk to Aggie in Draynor Village and ask for yellow dye (2 onions and 5 coins).
options: Can you make dyes for me please?
What do you need to make yellow dye?
Okay, make me some yellow dye please.

dyeWig.text: Use the yellow dye on the wig.

skirt.text: Buy a pink skirt from Thessalia in Varrock.

redberries.text: Pick up some redberries south-east of Varrock.

flour.text: Get a pot of flour: put grain in the hopper at the mill north of Lumbridge, pull the lever and use a pot on the flour bin.

ashes.text: Light a fire with logs and a tinderbox, and pick up the ashes when it burns out.

getWater.text: Fill a bucket or jug with water at a well.

paste.text: Talk to Aggie and ask her to make skin paste.
options: Could you think of a way to make skin paste?
Yes please. Mix me some skin paste.

rope.text: Buy a rope from Ned in Draynor Village for 15 coins.
options: Yes, I would like some rope.
Okay, please sell me some rope.

leela.text: Bring the key, wig, skirt and paste to Leela.

beer.text: Buy 3 beers, from the bartender in the Rusty Anchor in Port Sarim.
options: Could I buy a beer please?

joe.text: Talk to Joe, the guard at the jail door, and give him the beers.
options: I have some beer here, fancy one?

tieKeli.text: Use the rope on Lady Keli.

door.text: Use the key on the prince's cell door.

prince.text: Talk to Prince Ali and give him the disguise and the key.

finish.text: Return to Hassan in the Al Kharid palace for your reward.

rewards: Free use of the Al Kharid toll gate

ratcatch.name: Rat Catchers
ratcatch.start: Talk to Gertrude, west of Varrock, with a cat.

cat.name: A cat (not a kitten or a lazy cat)

milk.name: Bucket of milk
milk.tip: Use a bucket on a dairy cow

horn.name: Unicorn horn dust
horn.tip: Grind a unicorn horn with a pestle and mortar

pot.name: Pot
pot.tip: Sold by the Lumbridge general store

skills: Gertrude's Cat and Icthlarin's Little Helper completed

start.text: With your cat, talk to Gertrude west of Varrock about the Ratcatchers.
options: Talk about the 'Ratcatchers' quest.

sisters.text: Find Grimesquit and Phingspet in the Varrock sewers and talk to them with your cat.

rats.text: Drop your cat in the sewers and let it catch 8 rats.

jimmy.text: Talk to Jimmy Dazzler, west of the Flying Horse Inn in Ardougne.

mansion.text: Read Jimmy's directions to go to the mansion. Without being seen, let your cat catch the six rats, then leave.
options: Follow the directions to the house.
Yes, let's get out of here!

jimmy2.text: Tell Jimmy Dazzler the mansion is clear.

jack.text: Talk to Hooknosed Jack in south-east Varrock.
options: Can I help?

poison.text: Bring Jack kwuarm, red spiders' eggs and a vial for rat poison, use it on cheese, and use the poisoned cheese on the four rat holes upstairs in the warehouse south of the Dancing Donkey.
options: Can you make me some rat poison?

jack2.text: Tell Hooknosed Jack you have finished the job.
options: I've finished the job.

apothecary.text: Ask the Apothecary in Varrock about cats.
options: I need to talk to you about cats.

antipoison.text: Bring the Apothecary a bucket of milk, unicorn horn dust and marrentill for a cat antipoison, and give it to Pox, Jack's cat.
options: I need to talk to you about cats.

pox.text: Give the cat antipoison to Pox.

kingrat.text: Use your cat on the hole in the warehouse wall upstairs to send it after the King rat.
options: Be careful in there, cat!

jack3.text: Tell Hooknosed Jack the King rat is dead.

joe.text: Talk to Smokin' Joe in Keldagrim.
options: I could help you.

smoke.text: Fill a pot with weeds, light it with a tinderbox and use it on the rat hole.

smoke2.text: Wear a catspeak amulet and smoke the hole again with your cat ready to catch the rats.

joe2.text: Tell Smokin' Joe his rats are caught.

face.text: Talk to the Face in Port Sarim.

felkrash.text: Go down the manhole by the Face and talk to Felkrash in the rat pits.

face2.text: Ask the Face about Felkrash's story.

charmer.text: Talk to the snake charmer in Pollnivneach about animal charming and bargain for his music.
options: I want to talk to you about animal charming.
What if I offered you some money?
Walk away slowly
Stop

play.text: Read the music and play it on the snake charm on the docks of Port Sarim.

finish.text: Tell Felkrash every rat in the port is gone.

rewards: Felkrash trains overgrown cats into wily cats

regicide.name: Regicide
regicide.start: Some time after Underground Pass a royal messenger finds you with King Lathas's summons.

barrel.name: Barrel
barrel.tip: Barrels lie around Tyras's camp and Lord Iorwerth's

pot.name: Pot
pot.tip: The quartermaster in Tyras's camp sells them

skills: Able to defeat a level 70 soldier

on: the chemist takes the book and starts leafing through the pages
you cooked me a rabbit thanks a lot you don t mind watching things while i take 5 to eat it do you
give us a minute to finish eating this rabbit

start.text: Talk to the King's messenger who comes looking for you, and take the summons.

lathas.text: Talk to King Lathas upstairs in East Ardougne castle.

passIn.text: Go back down into the Underground Pass and through it to the skull doors into the main cavern (the way you took before).

pass.text: Go back through the Underground Pass to Iban's temple: its doors now open onto the Well of Voyage. Koftik waits there with some food.

well.text: Climb down the Well of Voyage, then leave the temple below by its exit into Isafdar.

templeExit.text: Leave the temple by its exit into Isafdar.

scouts.text: Walk on into the woods; an elf scout runs up to you while two others shoot at him. Hear him out.

iorwerth.text: Find Lord Iorwerth at his camp in the north-west of the woods.

tracker.text: Meet Iorwerth's tracker at Tyras's abandoned camp to the south-east.

pendant.text: The tracker wants proof: ask Lord Iorwerth for his crystal pendant.

showPendant.text: Show the tracker the crystal pendant.

footprints.text: Search the west side of the old camp for tracks.

tracker2.text: Ask the tracker about the tracks; he tells you how to get through the dense forest.

guard.text: Follow the tracks west through the dense forest (56 Agility) and kill the soldier of Tyras who attacks you.

camp.text: Go on west to Tyras's camp and squeeze into it through the forest; look around.

iorwerth2.text: Tell Lord Iorwerth about the camp; he gives you a book.

chemist.text: Take the book to the chemist in Rimmington and ask about the formula.
options: What is and how do I make naphtha?

barrel.text: Pick up a barrel (some lie by Lord Iorwerth's camp and in Tyras's camp).

tar.text: Fill the barrel with coal tar at the tar pool south-east of the old camp.

still.text: Use the barrel of coal tar on the chemist's still in Rimmington and distil it into naphtha, keeping the heat and pressure right (bring plenty of coal).

quicklime.text: Heat limestone in a furnace to make quicklime (gloves save your hands).

grindQ.text: Grind the quicklime into a pot with a pestle and mortar.

sulphur.text: Collect sulphur from the yellow deposits south-east of the old camp.

grindS.text: Grind the sulphur with a pestle and mortar.

mix.text: Add the ground quicklime and the ground sulphur to the naphtha to make a barrel bomb.

loom.text: Weave 4 balls of wool into cloth on the loom at Lord Iorwerth's camp (10 Crafting).

fuse.text: Use the cloth on the barrel bomb to make a fuse.

rabbit.text: Give the lazy guard at Tyras's catapult a cooked rabbit; he takes a break to eat it.

catapult.text: While the guard eats, load the fused barrel bomb into the catapult and fire it at Tyras's tent.

iorwerth3.text: Tell Lord Iorwerth that Tyras is dead; he gives you a message for King Lathas.

arianwyn.text: Take the message to Ardougne: by the castle an elf, Arianwyn, stops you and opens it.

finish.text: Tell King Lathas about the death of his brother.

rewards: Access to Tirannwn and the Arandar pass

romeojuliet.name: Romeo & Juliet
romeojuliet.start: Talk to Romeo in Varrock Square.

message.name: Message
message.tip: Juliet gives you another if you lose it

berries.name: Cadava berries
berries.tip: From the bushes south-east of Varrock

romeo.text: Talk to Romeo in Varrock Square.
options: Can I help find her for you?

goUp.text: Climb the stairs in Juliet's house, west of Varrock.

juliet.text: Talk to Juliet upstairs in her house west of Varrock.

message.text: Bring Juliet's message to Romeo in Varrock Square.

lawrence.text: Talk to Father Lawrence in the church in north-east Varrock.

berries.text: Pick up some cadava berries by the bushes south-east of Varrock.

apothecary.text: Bring the cadava berries to the Apothecary in south-west Varrock.

goUp2.text: Bring the potion to Juliet: climb the stairs in her house.

potion.text: Give the cadava potion to Juliet.

finish.text: Talk to Romeo in Varrock Square to finish the quest.

runemysteries.name: Rune Mysteries Quest
runemysteries.start: Talk to Duke Horacio on the first floor of Lumbridge Castle.

talisman.name: Air talisman
talisman.tip: Duke Horacio gives you another if you lose it

package.name: Research package
package.tip: Sedridor gives you another if you lose it

notes.name: Research notes
notes.tip: Aubury gives you another if you lose them

goUp.text: Climb the staircase in Lumbridge Castle to the first floor.

duke.text: Talk to Duke Horacio on the first floor of Lumbridge Castle.
options: Have you any quests for me?
Sure, no problem.
Climb down the stairs.

tower.text: Climb down the ladder into the Wizards' Tower basement, south of Draynor.

giveTalisman.text: Give the air talisman to Sedridor, the head wizard, in the basement.
options: I'm looking for the head wizard.
Ok, here you are.

getPackage.text: Talk to Sedridor again and agree to take his research package to Aubury.
options: Yes, certainly.

aubury.text: Bring the research package to Aubury in his rune shop in south-east Varrock.

auburyAgain.text: Talk to Aubury again for his research notes.

giveNotes.text: Bring the research notes to Sedridor in the Wizards' Tower basement.

rewards: Access to the Rune Essence mine

scorpcatcher.name: Scorpion Catcher
scorpcatcher.start: Talk to Thormac at the top of the Sorcerer's Tower south of Seers' Village.

cage.name: Scorpion cage
cage.tip: Thormac gives it (and another if you lose it)

gotB.name: Cage with the Barbarian Outpost scorpion

skills: Able to get past the monsters in Taverley Dungeon

start.text: Talk to Thormac at the top of the Sorcerer's Tower.
options: What do you need assistance with?
So how would I go about catching them then?
Ok, I will do it then.

seer.text: Talk to the Seer in Seers' Village.
options: I need to locate some scorpions.

scorpA.text: Go into Taverley Dungeon, through the secret wall, and use the cage on the scorpion.

seer2.text: Talk to the Seer again for where the next scorpion is.

scorpC.text: Use the cage on the scorpion upstairs in the Monastery south of Edgeville.

peksa.text: Ask Peksa in Barbarian Village about his scorpion.
options: I've heard you have a small scorpion in your possession.

scorpB.text: Use the cage on the scorpion at the Barbarian Outpost.

finish.text: Bring the full cage to Thormac.

sheep.name: Sheep Shearer
sheep.start: Talk to Fred the Farmer north-west of Lumbridge.

shears.name: Shears
shears.tip: There is a pair in Fred's house

start.text: Talk to Fred the Farmer north-west of Lumbridge to start the quest.
options: I'm looking for a quest.
Yes okay. I can do that.
Yes, okay. I can do that.

getShears.text: Pick up the shears in Fred's house.

shear.text: Shear the sheep in the field next to Fred until you have enough wool.

goUp.text: Climb the staircase in Lumbridge Castle to the spinning wheel.

spin.text: Spin your wool into balls of wool on the spinning wheel.

options: Climb down the stairs.

handIn.text: Bring Fred your balls of wool. You can hand in some at a time.

sheepherder.name: Sheep Herder
sheepherder.start: Talk to Councillor Halgrive in East Ardougne.

feed.name: Poisoned sheep feed
feed.tip: Councillor Halgrive gives it (and more if you lose it)

jacket.name: Protective jacket
jacket.tip: Doctor Orbon sells the outfit for 100 coins

prod.name: Cattleprod
prod.tip: Lies in the sheep pen by Farmer Brumty

start.text: Talk to Councillor Halgrive in Ardougne.
options: What's wrong?
I can do that for you.

orbon.text: Buy protective clothing from Doctor Orbon, next to the councillor.
options: Ok, I'll take it.

prod.text: Wear the protective clothing, go into the pen north of Ardougne by Farmer Brumty and pick up the cattleprod.

sheep.text: Wield the cattleprod and prod each of the four diseased sheep (around the farms north of Ardougne) into the pen, then use the poisoned feed on each one there. When all four are burnt, talk to Councillor Halgrive.

burn.text: Put the sheep bones in the furnace by the pen.

finish.text: Once all four sheep are burnt, return to Councillor Halgrive.

squire.name: The Knight's Sword
squire.start: Talk to the Squire in the courtyard of Falador castle.

pie.name: Redberry pie
pie.tip: Use redberries on a pie shell and bake it on a range (10 Cooking)

blurite.name: Blurite ore
blurite.tip: Mine it in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon south of Port Sarim (10 Mining)

iron.name: Iron bar
iron.tip: Smelt iron ore at a furnace (15 Smithing)

start.text: Talk to the Squire in the courtyard of Falador castle.
options: And how is life as a squire?
Is he angry?
Well, the kingdom is fairly abundant with swords...
So would these dwarves make another one?
Ok, I'll give it a go.

reldo.text: Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Palace library.
options: What do you know about the Imcando dwarves?

pie.text: Bring a redberry pie to Thurgo on the cliffs south of Port Sarim.
options: Would you like a redberry pie?

thurgo.text: Talk to Thurgo again and ask him to make the sword.

cupboard.text: Search Sir Vyvin's cupboard on the top floor of Falador castle for the portrait, while Sir Vyvin is not near it.

blurite.text: Mine a blurite ore in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon (in the cave south of Port Sarim). Ice warriors and giants guard it.

sword.text: Bring the blurite ore and 2 iron bars to Thurgo.

finish.text: Bring the sword to the Squire.

rum.name: Karamjan rum

corpse.name: Monkey corpse
corpse.tip: Monkeys drop it while the quest is going

bones.name: Jogre bones
bones.tip: From the Jogres east of the village

skills: Recommended: 30 Firemaking or 43 Magic to burn the Jogre bones (or use a furnace)

start.text: Talk to Timfraku upstairs in his hut, tell him Trufitus sent you, and agree to find his sons.
options: I am a roving adventurer.
Trufitus sent me.
Your gratitude is all I deserve.
Yes

lubufu.text: Talk to Lubufu on the north coast by Brimhaven, ask what he does and how old he is, and offer to help collect his bait.
options: Who are you?
Talk about him...
What do you do?
How old are you?
I could help collect the bait.
You sound like you could do with the help.

fishJi.text: Net 20 raw karambwanji at the shoal by the Holy Lake, south of Tai Bwo Wannai.
fishJi.note: Catch a few extra: you need more for Tiadeche and Tinsay.

apprentice.text: Ask Lubufu three questions about Karambwan, then agree to be his apprentice; he gives you a Karambwan vessel.
options: What is a Karambwan?
What do you do with your Karambwan?
What do you use to catch Karambwan?
Yes!

tiadeche.text: Find Tiadeche fishing on the coast east of the village and give him the news.

loadVessel.text: Load the Karambwan vessel with raw karambwanji and use it on Tiadeche; take his first catch.
options: Yes

tamayu.text: Find Tamayu hunting in the jungle south of the village, give him the news and go on his next hunt.
options: When will you succeed?
Yes

agility.text: Give Tamayu 4 doses of agility potion.

paste.text: Cook the raw karambwan (it comes out poorly cooked), grind it with a pestle and mortar and use the paste on an iron or better spear.

spear.text: Give Tamayu the Karambwan poisoned spear.

hunt.text: Ask Tamayu to take you on his next hunt; this time he slays the Shaikahan.
options: Take me on your next hunt for the Shaikahan

tinsay.text: Find Tinsay on the cliffs south of the Holy Lake and give him the news.

bananaRum.text: Slice a banana with a knife, add the slices to Karamjan rum and use it on Tinsay.

askSandwich.text: Talk to Tinsay again for his next wish.

monkey.text: Kill a monkey by the Holy Lake for its corpse (use ranged or magic), then use the corpse on Tamayu to have it skinned.

sandwich.text: Use seaweed on the monkey skin and give the sandwich to Tinsay.

askBones.text: Talk to Tinsay again for his last wish.

jogre.text: Kill Jogres east of the village for Jogre bones.

burn.text: Burn the Jogre bones: light them on the ground with a tinderbox (30 Firemaking), cast Superheat Item on them, or put them in any furnace.

marinate.text: Grind a raw karambwanji into paste, put it on the burnt bones and cook them on a fire or range.

giveBones.text: Give the marinated burnt Jogre bones to Tinsay.

newVessel.text: Ask Lubufu for another vessel (say you've lost yours).
options: Actually, I've lost my Karambwan vessel.
... a shark ate it!

tinsayVessel.text: Use the Karambwan vessel on Tinsay; he draws up crafting instructions.

manual.text: Give the crafting manual to Tiadeche.

finish.text: All three sons are coming home: tell Timfraku.
options: Eternal gratitude accepted.

rewards: The brothers each give a reward in the village afterwards

tog.name: Tears of Guthix
tog.start: Talk to Juna the serpent in the chasm deep beneath the Lumbridge Swamp Caves.

light.name: A light source
light.tip: The Lumbridge Swamp Caves are dark

lantern.name: Bullseye lantern
lantern.tip: Its lens is swapped for a sapphire

sapphire.name: Sapphire
sapphire.tip: Cut, for the lantern lens (20 Crafting)

start.text: With a light, go down into the Lumbridge Swamp Caves (the hole by the swamp south-west of Lumbridge), cross the stepping stones and climb down into the chasm. Climb the rocks to Juna and tell her a story.
options: Okay...

lantern.text: Use a sapphire on your bullseye lantern for a sapphire lens (20 Crafting) and light it.

cross.text: From the chasm's north ledge, shine the sapphire lantern on a light creature; it carries you across to the south. Mine some magic stone from the blue rocks there.

bowl.text: Use a chisel on the magic stone to make a stone bowl.

finish.text: Climb down the rocks east of the south ledge and take the bowl back to Juna.

rewards: Access to the Tears of Guthix cave

totem.name: Tribal Totem
totem.start: Talk to Kangai Mau in the food store in Brimhaven.

label.name: Address label
label.tip: Peeled off a crate in the RPDT depot in Ardougne

start.text: Talk to Kangai Mau in the food store in Brimhaven.
options: I'm in search of adventure!
Tell me of this mission.
Ok, I will get it back.

label.text: Investigate the crate in the RPDT depot in Ardougne and take its label.

crate.text: Use the label on the other crate in the depot.

employee.text: Talk to the RPDT employee and ask about the delivery.
options: So, when are you going to deliver this crate?

cromperty.text: Talk to Wizard Cromperty in north-east Ardougne and have him teleport you.
options: So what have you invented?
Can I be teleported please?
Yes, that sounds good. Teleport me!

door.text: Open the door with the combination K U R T.

stairs.text: Search the stairs for traps (21 Thieving) to note the trap, then climb them.

chest.text: Open the chest upstairs and take the totem.

finish.text: Bring the totem to Kangai Mau in Brimhaven.

tree.name: Tree Gnome Village
tree.start: Talk to King Bolren in the middle of the Tree Gnome Village maze.
skills: Able to defeat a level 112 Khazard warlord (he can be safespotted)

start.text: Talk to King Bolren in the middle of the maze. Elkoy at the maze entrance can show you through.
options: Can I help at all?
I would be glad to help.

montai.text: Talk to Commander Montai at the battlefield north of the maze.
options: Ok, I'll gather some wood.
I'll try my best.

tracker1.text: Talk to the tracker gnome by the stronghold for the height coordinate (4).

tracker2.text: Talk to the captured tracker gnome through the bars of his cell for the y coordinate (5).

tracker3.text: The third tracker gnome answers in riddles; the x coordinate is 3.

ballista.text: Fire the ballista: height 0004, x 0003, y 0005.

wall.text: Climb over the crumbled wall of the Khazard stronghold. The Khazard commander attacks.

chest.text: Go upstairs and search the open chest for the orb of protection.

bolren.text: Bring the orb to King Bolren.
options: I will find the warlord and bring back the orbs.

warlord.text: Kill the Khazard warlord north-west of the battlefield; you take the orbs from his satchel.

finish.text: Bring the orbs to King Bolren.

troll.name: Troll Stronghold
troll.start: Talk to Denulth in his tent at the Imperial Guard camp in Burthorpe.

prisonKey.name: Prison key
prisonKey.tip: Dropped by a troll general in the stronghold

key1.name: Cell key 1
key1.tip: Dropped by the prison guard Twig

key2.name: Cell key 2
key2.tip: Dropped by the prison guard Berry

skills: Able to defeat the level 113 Troll Champion

start.text: Ask Denulth how his fight with the trolls goes and offer to get Godric back.
options: How goes your fight with the trolls?
Is there anything I can do to help?
I'll get Godric back!

dad.text: Wearing climbing boots, climb the rocks north of Death Plateau to the troll arena, accept the Troll Champion's challenge and defeat him.
options: I accept your challenge!

stronghold.text: Go through the arena and over the mountain to the Troll Stronghold. Inside, kill a troll general for the prison key and go down to the prison door.

cells.text: In the prison, kill the guards Twig and Berry for the two cell keys and unlock Godric's and Mad Eadgar's cells.

finish.text: Tell Dunstan in Burthorpe that his son is safe.

troll_love.name: Troll Romance
troll_love.start: Talk to Ug in the Troll Stronghold.

bucketWax.name: Bucket of wax
bucketWax.tip: From a beehive in Catherby: pour insect repellent on it, then use an empty bucket

start.text: Talk to Ug in the Troll Stronghold.
options: Awww, you poor troll. What seems to be the problem?
Don't worry now, I'll see what I can do.

aga.text: Ask Aga, in the north of the stronghold, about her love life.
options: So... how's your... um... love life?

tenzing.text: Ask Tenzing west of Burthorpe where to find Trollweiss and what you need for a sled.
options: Do you know where I can find Trollweiss?
What would I need to make such a sled?

dunstan.text: Ask Dunstan in Burthorpe for a sled, and bring him maple or yew logs, an iron bar and a rope.
options: I need a sled!!

wax.text: Mix a bucket of wax with swamp tar in a cake tin, and use the wax on the sled.

flower.text: Go through the cave north-west of Trollheim and out of the crevasse onto Trollweiss Mountain. Wear the waxed sled, ride down the slope and pick some Trollweiss.

ug.text: With the waxed sled still worn, ride the lower slope down from its barrier to the foot of the mountain, go back through the tunnel to Trollheim and give the Trollweiss to Ug.

arrg.text: Challenge Arrg, beside Aga, and defeat him outside.
options: I am here to kill you!

finish.text: Tell Ug that Arrg is defeated.

rewards: An uncut diamond, 2 uncut rubies and 4 uncut emeralds

twocats.name: A Tail of Two Cats
twocats.start: Talk to Unferth at his house in Burthorpe, with your cat following you.

robes.name: White robes (desert, druid or doctor's gown)

skills: Icthlarin's Little Helper and Gertrude's Cat completed
A cat or kitten following you

start.text: With your cat following you and the amulet of catspeak on, talk to Unferth in Burthorpe and offer to find his cat Bob.
options: Yes.

hild.text: Talk to Hild in the house just up the road.

runes.text: Give Hild five death runes to enchant your amulet.

bob.text: Open the enchanted amulet and turn its whiskers until the eyes light up, then head that way to find Bob and talk to him.

gertrude.text: Ask Gertrude, west of Varrock, about Bob's parents.
options: Ask about Bob's parents.

reldo.text: Ask Reldo in the Varrock palace library about the legend.
options: I have a cat related question.

bob2.text: Find Bob again and ask him about Robert the Strong.

sphinx.text: Ask the Sphinx in Sophanem to help Bob remember.
options: Ask the Sphinx for help for Bob.
View the cutscene (5 mins 20 secs).

chores.text: Do Bob's chores at Unferth's house: make the bed, light a fire in the fireplace, put a chocolate cake and milk on the table, cut Unferth's hair with shears, and rake the patch and plant 4 potato seeds (wait for them to grow).
chores.note: Your cat explains each chore ("Ask about the chores Bob set you to do.").

unferth.text: Talk to Unferth to see if he needs anything else.

apothecary.text: Ask the Apothecary in Varrock to see Unferth; pick a hat.
options: Talk about A Tail of Two Cats.
Doctor's hat.

doctor.text: Dressed as a doctor or nurse (the hat, white top and bottom, nothing in your hands), give Unferth a vial of water.

bob3.text: Find Bob, back from his holiday.

finish.text: Tell Unferth about Bob.

rewards: A present from Unferth: two antique lamps of 2,500 experience and a mouse toy

rope.name: Rope

plank.name: Plank

start.text: Ask King Lathas whether his scouts have found a way through the mountains.

koftik.text: Talk to Koftik by the cave entrance at the west side of West Ardougne.

koftik2.text: Go into the cave and ask Koftik at the bridge how to cross; he gives you a damp cloth.

cloth.text: Use the damp cloth on an arrow.

light.text: Light the cloth-wrapped arrow with a tinderbox (or on a fire).

bridge.text: Wield your bow and the lit arrow and shoot the rope holding up the bridge, standing on this side north of it; then cross.

swing.text: Pick up the plank west of the bridge, then head south: tie your rope to the rock and swing over the chasm, climb over the rockslides and pull the lever to get through the portcullis into the cavern of the orbs.
swing.note: The floor past the portcullis is trapped: only some squares in each column are safe.

orbs.text: Collect the four orbs of light in this cavern (one sits behind a log trap you disarm, others past spring traps you cross with the plank) and throw each into the furnace to the east; once all four are gone, climb into the well.

furnace.text: Throw the orb of light into the furnace.

railing.text: Make your way along the ledge and the narrow walkways and squeeze through the pipe; search the unicorn cage for a loose railing.

boulder.text: Use the railing on the boulder above the unicorn cage.

horn.text: Search the smashed unicorn cage for the horn.

paladins.text: Go through the doors to the north and kill the three paladins (Sir Jerro, Sir Carl and Sir Harry) for their badges.

bloodwell.text: Throw the unicorn horn and the three badges into the well by the great doors.

door.text: Go through the doors with the skull above them into the main cavern.

nilhoof.text: Take the tunnel down to the dwarves in the south of the cavern and talk to Niloof.

cat.text: Back up in the cavern, jump the gaps to the witch's house and pick up her cat, which wanders north-west of it.

witchDoor.text: Use the cat on the witch's door; while she plays with it, search her chest.

chest.text: Search the witch's chest for the doll of Iban.

brew.text: Get Klank's gauntlets and a tinderbox from Klank, then fill a bucket from the dwarves' brew barrel.

pour.text: Pour the dwarf brew over Iban's tomb.

burn.text: Set fire to Iban's tomb with a tinderbox and take his ashes.

rubAshes.text: Rub Iban's ashes into the doll.

kalrag.text: With the doll in your pack, kill Kalrag, the giant spider, down the other tunnel; its blood soaks the doll.

demons.text: Kill the three demons, Othainian, Doomion and Holthion, near the witch's house for their amulets.

shadowChest.text: Open the demons' chest with the three amulets and take Iban's shadow.

rubShadow.text: Pour Iban's shadow over the doll.

cage.text: Wearing Klank's gauntlets, search the cage of the soulless at the north of the cavern for Iban's dove.

rubDove.text: Crush the dove's bones into the doll.

temple.text: Wearing only the Zamorak robe top and bottom, open the doors of Iban's temple.

pit.text: Throw the doll of Iban into the pit of the damned.

koftikOut.text: Talk to Koftik where you landed; he leads you out.

finish.text: Tell King Lathas that Iban is destroyed.

sections.title: Iban's flesh, blood, shadow and conscience

rewards: Iban's staff and the Iban Blast spell
Access to the Well of Voyage (later)
