start.text: Talk to Chieftain Brundt in the Longhall and ask to join the Fremennik.
options: Do you have any quests?
Yes, I am interested.
I want to become a Fremennik!

manni.text: Talk to Manni the Reveller in the Longhall and agree to a drinking contest.
options: Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Yes

poison.text: Buy a low alcohol keg from the poison salesman in the Seers' Village pub (250 coins).
options: Talk about the Fremennik Trials
Yes

workman.text: Use a beer on the council workman by the bridge south of Rellekka; he gives you a strange object.

pipe.text: Light the strange object with a tinderbox and put it in the pipe on the east wall of the Longhall.

keg.text: Take the keg of beer from the table by the bar, then use the low alcohol keg on it while the bang draws everyone outside.

drink.text: Talk to Manni with your (low alcohol) keg and start the contest.
options: Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Yes

swensen.text: Talk to Swensen the Navigator and agree to try his maze.
options: Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Yes

maze.text: Climb down the ladder by Swensen's house. In the maze, follow the route line through the right portals to the exit ladder and climb it.
maze.note: Seven portals lead the right way; any other sends you somewhere random in the maze.

sigli.text: Talk to Sigli the Huntsman and agree to hunt the Draugen; he gives you a talisman.
options: Ask about becoming a Fremennik
What's a Draugen?
Yes

draugen.text: Use the talisman to track the Draugen (it shows up in the woods around Rellekka and north of Seers' Village) and defeat it.

sigliBack.text: Give the charged talisman to Sigli.

peer.text: Talk to Peer the Seer and agree to his trial; let him bank everything you carry (you must enter with nothing).
options: Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Yes

peerDoor.text: Solve the riddle on Peer's front door with your inventory and equipment empty. The answers are MIND, TREE, LIFE, FIRE, TIME or WIND.

peerSearch.text: Climb the ladder. Upstairs, take the disks from the unicorn and bull heads, the red herring from the bookcase, the bucket from the cupboard and the jug from the chest.

peerCook.text: Use the red herring on the range, then the red goop on the wooden disk.

peerMural.text: Downstairs, put both red disks in the mural; its centre falls out as a vase lid.

peerScales.text: Upstairs, measure 4 gallons in the bucket (5) with the jug (3), the tap and the drain, and use the bucket on the chest with the scales for a vase.
peerScales.note: Fill the bucket, fill the jug from it, empty the jug, pour the bucket into the jug, fill the bucket, top up the jug from it: 4 left.

peerVase.text: Fill the vase at the tap, screw the lid on, and use it on the frozen table.

peerThaw.text: Melt the ice off the key on the range.

peerExit.text: Downstairs, use the key on the back door and go out.

thorvald.text: Talk to Thorvald the Warrior and agree to fight his champion.
options: Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Yes

koschei.text: With no weapons or armour at all, climb down the ladder by Thorvald and defeat Koschei the Deathless (four times; he heals each time).

olaf.text: Talk to Olaf the Bard and agree to his trial.
options: Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Yes

tree.text: Cut a branch from the musical tree east of Rellekka.

lyre.text: Use a knife on the branch to make an unstrung lyre.

lalliTalk.text: Talk to Lalli the troll by the golden apple tree east of Rellekka and ask about the other human.
options: Other human?

askeladden.text: Talk to Askeladden in Rellekka; he gives you a pet rock.
options: Ask about becoming a Fremennik

lalliRock.text: Talk to Lalli again with the pet rock.

stew.text: Put the pet rock, a cabbage, a potato and an onion in Lalli's cauldron, then talk to him.

fleece.text: Talk to Lalli; he swaps the golden fleece for your soup stone.

spin.text: Spin the golden fleece on the spinning wheel in Seers' Village (the Rellekka one is for Fremenniks only), then string the lyre with the wool.

shrine.text: Use a raw shark, sea turtle or manta ray on the Lake Shrine south-west of Rellekka to have Fossegrimen enchant your lyre.

stage.text: Go through the backstage door of the Longhall and play the enchanted lyre on the stage.

sigmund.text: Talk to Sigmund the Merchant and agree to find his flower.
options: Ask about becoming a Fremennik
Yes

qSailor.text: Ask the sailor on the docks about the merchant's trial.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

qOlaf.text: Ask Olaf the Bard about the merchant's trial.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

qYrsa.text: Ask Yrsa in the clothes shop about the merchant's trial.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

qBrundt.text: Ask Chieftain Brundt about the merchant's trial.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

qSigli.text: Ask Sigli about the merchant's trial.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

qSkul.text: Ask Skulgrimen in the armour shop about the merchant's trial.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

qFisher.text: Ask the fisherman on the pier about the merchant's trial.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

qSwensen.text: Ask Swensen about the merchant's trial.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

qPeer.text: Ask Peer about the merchant's trial.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

qThorvald.text: Ask Thorvald about the merchant's trial.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

qManni.text: Ask Manni about the merchant's trial.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

qThora.text: Ask Thora the barkeeper in the Longhall about the merchant's trial.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

qAskeladden.text: Ask Askeladden about the merchant's trial and pay him 5,000 coins for his promise.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial
Yes

tThora.text: Give Askeladden's promise to Thora for the legendary cocktail.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

tManni.text: Give the cocktail to Manni for his champions token.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

tThorvald.text: Give the champions token to Thorvald for his contract.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

tPeer.text: Give the contract to Peer for a weather forecast.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

tSwensen.text: Give the forecast to Swensen for his fishing map.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

tFisher.text: Give the map to the fisherman for the unusual fish.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

tSkul.text: Give the fish to Skulgrimen for the bow string.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

tSigli.text: Give the bow string to Sigli for his hunting map.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

tBrundt.text: Give the map to Brundt for the tax report.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

tYrsa.text: Give the report to Yrsa for the sturdy boots.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

tOlaf.text: Give the boots to Olaf for his ballad.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

tSailor.text: Give the ballad to the sailor for the exotic flower.
options: Ask about the Merchant's trial

tSigmund.text: Give the exotic flower to Sigmund.

finish.text: You have seven votes: tell Chieftain Brundt.

rewards: 2,812 experience in Agility, Attack, Crafting, Defence, Fishing, Fletching, Hitpoints, Strength, Thieving and Woodcutting
Fremennik membership and a Fremennik name

wanted.name: Wanted!
wanted.start: Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador park.

orbParts.name: Law rune, enchanted gem and molten glass (or 10,000 coins)
orbParts.tip: For Sir Tiffy to make your CommOrb

skills: Recruitment Drive, The Lost Tribe and Priest in Peril completed

start.text: Talk to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador park.
options: Yes.

amik.text: Tell Sir Amik Varze, at the top of the White Knights' castle, that you want to be a White Knight; turn down being his squire and ask to be deputised.
options: No, not right now...

tiffy.text: Tell Sir Tiffy that Sir Amik can only deputise you in a crisis.

amik2.text: Report to Sir Amik Varze for orders.
options: Sure, I'll help you!

tiffy2.text: Ask Sir Tiffy for advice on finding Solus; he makes you a CommOrb from a law rune, an enchanted gem and molten glass (or sells one for 10,000 coins).

savant.text: Use the CommOrb to contact Savant.

leads.text: Question Lord Daquarius in Taverley Dungeon and the Mage of Zamorak in Varrock (he wants 20 rune essence) about Solus Dellagar.
options: Solus Dellagar.

mage.text: Ask the Mage of Zamorak in Varrock about Solus Dellagar.
options: Solus Dellagar.

hunt.text: Scan for Solus in Canifis with the CommOrb. Each time he teleports away, follow the clue item Savant pulls from his teleport to the next place and scan again, until he is trapped in the rune essence mine.

aubury.text: Ask Aubury in his rune shop in Varrock to teleport you to the rune essence mine.

fight.text: Defeat Solus Dellagar in the rune essence mine.

finish.text: Take Solus's hat to Sir Amik Varze.

waterfall.name: Waterfall Quest
waterfall.start: Talk to Almera in her house by the Baxtorian Falls, north of the Fishing Guild.

rope.name: Rope
rope.tip: Sold by general stores such as Arhein's in Catherby

book.name: Book on Baxtorian
book.tip: In the bookcase upstairs in Hadley's house

amulet.name: Glarial's amulet
amulet.tip: In the chest in Glarial's tomb

urn.name: Glarial's urn
urn.tip: In the coffin in Glarial's tomb

bkey.name: Key (Baxtorian's doors)
bkey.tip: In a crate inside the waterfall

skills: Able to survive a few level 30-ish monsters

start.text: Talk to Almera in her house by the Baxtorian Falls.
options: How can I help?

raft.text: Board the log raft behind the house; it crashes on the island where Hudon is.

bookcase.text: Go to Hadley's house south of the falls, climb upstairs and search the bookcase for the Book on Baxtorian.

ladderGnome.text: Go to the Tree Gnome Village and climb down the ladder in its north-east.

crate.text: Search the crate in the east of the cave for a key. Watch out for the hobgoblins.

gate.text: Use the key on Golrie's gate and talk to Golrie; take Glarial's pebble from his junk.

tombstone.text: Bank every weapon, piece of armour and rune (nothing of those may be carried in), then use Glarial's pebble on her tombstone east of Hadley's house.

chest.text: Search the chest in the tomb for Glarial's amulet.

coffin.text: Search Glarial's coffin for her urn.

runes.text: Get 6 air, 6 earth and 6 water runes (and a rope) from the bank, and come back to Almera's house.

raftAgain.text: Board the log raft behind Almera's house again, wearing Glarial's amulet.

rock.text: Use the rope on the rock south of the island.

tree.text: Use the rope on the dead tree to lower yourself onto the ledge.

ledgeDoor.text: Open the door on the ledge, with Glarial's amulet on.

bkey.text: Search the crate in the east room for a key.

door.text: Use the key on the doors to the north-west to reach the room with the pillars.

pillars.text: Use an air, an earth and a water rune on each of the six pillars, then use Glarial's amulet on the statue.

chalice.text: Use Glarial's urn on the chalice to take the treasure. You need 5 free inventory spaces.

zogre.name: Zogre Flesh Eaters
zogre.start: Talk to Grish at Jiggig, the ogre ceremonial dance place in Feldip Hills.

knife.name: Knife
knife.tip: There's one in the ruined backpack in the tomb

key.name: Ogre gate key
key.tip: Grish gives it (and another if you lose it)

skills: Jungle Potion and Big Chompy Bird Hunting completed

on: you show the prism and the necromantic half page to the aged wizard

start.text: Talk to Grish at Jiggig and offer to check things out.
options: What are Zogres?
Can I help in any way?
Ok, I'll check things out then and report back.
Yes, I'm really sure!

guard.text: Talk to the ogre guard at the barricade east of Jiggig; he kicks it in for you.

lectern.text: Climb over the barricade and go down the steps into the tomb. Search the broken lectern for a torn page.

skeleton.text: Search the skeleton by the lectern, kill Brentle Vahn when he rises, then search the skeleton again and open the ruined backpack.

coffin.text: Search the coffin nearby, pick its lock with the knife, lift the lid and take the black prism.

zavistic.text: Ring the bell outside the Wizards' Guild in Yanille and show the black prism and torn page to Zavistic Rarve.

sithik.text: Climb the ladder to Sithik Ints' room in Yanille and ask him if you can look around. Then search his drawers, cupboard and wardrobe.
options: Do you mind if I look around?

sketch.text: Use papyrus on Sithik (with charcoal) to sketch his portrait, until you get a good likeness.

bartender.text: Show the tankard and the portrait to the bartender of the Dragon Inn in Yanille; he signs the portrait.

evidence.text: Ring the bell for Zavistic Rarve and show him your evidence.
options: I have some items that I'd like you to look at.

tea.text: Use the strange potion on Sithik's cup of tea.

question.text: Leave Sithik's room and come back up the ladder, then ask him how to remove the spell.
options: How do I remove the effects of the spell from the area?
I found who's responsible for the Zogres being here.

plinth.text: In the tomb, unlock the gates with the ogre gate key and go down the steps beyond. Search the plinth and kill Slash Bash (ranged is best).

artefact.text: Search the plinth again for the ogre artefact.

finish.text: Give the ogre artefact to Grish.
options: Yeah, I have them here!

rewards: The ability to make brutal arrows and cure disease potions

zombiequeen.name: Shilo Village
zombiequeen.start: Talk to Mosol Rei in the jungle of southern Karamja, outside Shilo Village.

light.name: Lit candle or torch
light.tip: Dropped into the fissure (it burns out)

chisel.name: Chisel
chisel.tip: Cuts the plaque, the bone key and the beads

wire.name: Bronze wire
wire.tip: Smith a bronze bar into wire

skills: Able to defeat three guardians (levels 91, 68 and 93)

start.text: Talk to Mosol Rei and offer to take his Wampum belt to the shaman.
options: Why do I need to run?
Rashiliyia? Who is she?
What can we do?
I'll go to see the Shaman.
Yes, I'm sure and I'll take the Wampum belt to Trufitus.

trufitus.text: Show the Wampum belt to Trufitus in Tai Bwo Wannai and promise to look for Ah Za Rhoon.
options: Mosol gave me something to show you.
Mosol Rei said something about a legend?
Why was it called Ah Za Rhoon?
I am going to search for Ah Za Rhoon!
Yes, I will seriously look for Ah Za Rhoon and I'd appreciate your help.

mound.text: Search the mound of earth in the jungle east of Shilo Village, then dig it up with a spade.

lightIt.text: Use a lit candle or torch on the fissure to see inside.

ropeIt.text: Tie a rope to the fissure.

enter.text: Climb down the fissure into Ah Za Rhoon (32 Agility).
options: Yes, I'll give it a go!

plaque.text: Cut the plaque from the marked stone with a chisel.

book.text: Search the rocks hiding a bookcase in the west for the tattered scroll.
options: Yes, I'm quite sure.

sacks.text: Wriggle through the rubble in the north-west to the southern caves and search the sacks in the south-east for the crumpled scroll.
options: Yes, I'll wriggle through.

gallows.text: Search the gallows and take down the corpse.
options: Yes, I may find something else on the corpse.

leave.text: Leave Ah Za Rhoon by the path through the waterfall in the east.
options: Yes, I'll follow the path.

bury.text: Bury Zadimus' corpse on the sacred ground in the middle of Tai Bwo Wannai; take the bone shard. (Trufitus can read the plaque for you.)

cairn.text: Read the tattered scroll, then go to Cairn Isle west of Shilo Village (climb the rocks and cross the bridge) and search the rocks for a crawl-way into Bervirius' tomb.
options: Yes please.
Yes Please, I can think of nothing nicer!

dolmen.text: Search the dolmen in Bervirius' tomb for the sword pommel, the locating crystal and the notes.

door.text: Search the palm trees north of Ah Za Rhoon and examine the bone lock on the hidden doors. Then use the chisel on the bone shard for a bone key, and on the sword pommel for bone beads; read the crumpled scroll and thread the beads on bronze wire for the Beads of the dead.

unlock.text: Use the bone key on Rashiliyia's tomb doors behind the palm trees.

gate.text: Wear the Beads of the dead and go through the gate in Rashiliyia's tomb.

bones.text: Climb down the rocks and put a bone in each of the three recesses in the carved tomb door.

rashDolmen.text: Search the dolmen in the tomb and defeat the three Nazastarool guardians; take Rashiliyia's remains.

finish.text: Take Rashiliyia's remains to Bervirius' tomb on Cairn Isle and use them on the dolmen.
